name: Rosary
definition: String of beads in decades with a crucifix, made to count the Catholic rosary prayers; five-decade, one-decade, finger, wrist and pocket rosaries are types, chaplets sold with them.
notes: Catholic Company sells Rosaries as a category with five-decade, one-decade, chaplet, bracelet and ring subcategories

name: Mala
definition: Loop of 108 (or 27, 54) beads with a guru bead and tassel, made to count mantra repetitions in Hindu and Buddhist practice; wrist malas are a short form.
notes: Art of Tibet sells Mala & Prayer Beads as a category (108 bead malas, short malas, bracelets)

name: Tasbih (misbaha)
definition: String of 33, 99 or 101 beads with a divider and tassel, made to count Muslim dhikr; sold in wood, stone, seed and resin and as 33-bead bracelets.
notes: Muslim Mall sells Tasbihs Misbahas as its own category (33 and 99 bead, wood, stone, bracelets)

name: Paschal candle
definition: Large candle blessed and lit at Easter, sold in beeswax or oil types with stands.
notes: Concordia Supply and churchsupplies.com list Paschal/Easter candles as their own category

name: Votive or devotional candle
definition: Small candle or glass-held light lit as a prayer or offering, in votive, vigil and 7-day devotional types.
notes: Concordia lists Votive & Tealight Candles and churchsupplies.com Devotional Candles as categories

name: Yahrzeit candle
definition: Long-burning memorial candle in a glass, lit on the anniversary of a death and on festivals in Jewish practice.
notes: aJudaica lists Yahrzeit Candles as its own candle category (26-hour candle)

name: Havdalah candle
definition: Braided multi-wick candle lit at the close of the Sabbath, sold plain, decorated or with a spice box.
notes: aJudaica has a Havdalah Candles category of 55 items
